comment: Super helpful professor, always willing to give students additional feedback. Classes were always interesting, and he really showed an interest into the work students do in class. I loved our lessons spent listening to different musical pieces; and enjoyed his feedback. He isn't a fast grader, but got better towards the end of the semester.
Unnecessary amounts of homework. Weekly quizzes. Never gave back an assignment.

I had Professor Broening for Sound Recording, and I really it. He's a little bit quirky, and you can tell he enjoys what he does. As someone with no musical background (at all), I left that class with a lot of useful info for making music. His assignments are solid, tests and quizzes are a bit hard, but if you show up to learn it, you'll pass.

Broening is a great professor-funny and helpful. He doesn't demand too much but challenges students creatively. Probably the only bad thing about the class was the mandatory 3-day concert attendance on a weekend. You have to spend time on compositions to do well but if you get stuck he is willing to help. Having some prior music experience helps.

His FYS doesn't have any textbooks so you have to print everything off of Blackboard which sucked up my print credits like nothing else. Otherwise, he's extremely knowledgeable and interesting in class. It's definitely one of the easier FYS classes since he doesn't do tests or anything but the papers are weighted very heavily.

Borrowed Music FYS.  Lots of reading, and everything has to be printed off blackboard.  As long as you skim it you should be alright.  Doesn't return papers in anything resembling a timely fashion, but is very knowledgeable and enthusiastic.  Interesting class overall

really nice, intelligent, helpful guy, but don't let that fool you.  he never gave you a grade back on a project all semester and then your final grade is not what you expect. also has a really bizarre taste in music
challenging class, but broening is a lot of fun...in a sardonic sort of way. Enjoyable teacher and I would deffinetly take another class taught by him
He's a great teacher - approachable, excited about his subjects, and interested in teaching students what they want to learn. He's also a lot of fun!

Doctor Broening is a great musician and a very dedicated professor. He knows what he is teaching because it is his passion, but unlike many he is also able to communicate the ideas behind music theory in an interesting and understandable way.
Broening is a brilliant musician.  Not only he the guy hilarious, but he's extremely clear in his explanation of the material.  Hard, but worth it.
Broening is a great teacher.  He's funny and extremely smart and knowledgable.  He has very high standards, which makes his classes challenging, but they are still fun.
